BIG: RSF Lt. Gen. Khalid Nour al-Daim Bresh has defected to Sudan's Army.
Bresh is a former army officer who was seconded to the RSF in 2013 and rose to senior roles in security, border affairs and logistics. 
Hemedti promoted him to lieutenant general in June 2026. 
Pro-army accounts say he is heading toward Khartoum with forces and equipment, and some also tie him to the attack on the army’s General Command and the fall of El Fasher.
RSF media chief Al-Tayeb Khalil called the reports “rumors” spread to cause confusion.

WATCH: A 47-year-old Chinese man used an excavator to smash the entrance of the Fengdong New City Government Service Centre near Xi’an, Shaanxi.
Special police detained him on site.
Chinese social media and local reports say it stems from a long dispute over unpaid compensation after his breeding farm was demolished, and that he had petitioned repeatedly, including in Beijing.
